description: Canonical glob patterns that no autonomous engine (any model provider) may write to, regardless of its own role allowlist. agents/autonomous_cloud_runner.py, agents/autonomous_orchestrator.py, agents/claude_specialist_runner.py, agents/claude_code_specialist_runner.py, and .github/workflows/autonomous_lead.yml all load this single list so protected-path enforcement cannot drift between engines or between generation-time and review-time checks.
